card.name: End of table header before a dose
card.fires_on: The unit label or blank space that ends a weight, body-surface-area or header cell in a dosing table, right before the dose amount is given.

modes.label: Weight or area unit
modes.description: The unit kg or m2 after a number in a weight or body-surface-area row, ahead of the dose.
modes.example: Patients Aged 6 Years and Older Age Weight Once Daily Oral Dosage 6 to less than 12 years old Less than 40<< kg>> Three tablets of vanzacaftor

modes.label: Gap before dose value
modes.description: The space between a table label and the dose or concentration that follows it.
modes.example: Dose Level Starting dose<< >>600 mg taken orally twice daily

card.writes: It pushes the next text toward a number, such as a tens-value like sixty or fifty, and away from words like reach.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing table where a weight or size cell ends and the dose number comes next.
